description: Source code for DSClient request handler managing STBService components, including initialization, handling get/set messages, and update checks.

classes.name: DSClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles device service client requests, including initialization, message handling, and update notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the device manager and prepares the handler.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Deinitializes and closes all STB service instances and device manager.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Processes set requests for STBService components like HDMI, VideoDecoder, AudioOutput, SPDIF.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Processes get requests for STBService components and retrieves their status or configuration.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for update notifications.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles retrieval of attribute notifications (stub implementation).

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles setting of attribute notifications (stub implementation).

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Iterates over all STBService component instances and triggers their update routines.
